opening.argument: The presentation ties paid packages to participation in coin mining, stating that tokens are used to buy slots for “the joint mining of the coin,” while identifying a package price of 5,000 euros. It further promises that viewers “can double tokens” and describes package-dependent matching bonuses extending across four generations, including 10% from a recruited first-generation participant. These are presented alongside recruitment-linked rewards and package sales, with the offer’s legitimacy remaining an unverified counterclaim. The material does not verify recipients, delivery, liquidity, actual transactions, or realized losses, so the observable case rests on paid mining returns, token-doubling claims, and recruitment incentives rather than demonstrated performance.
